scopeRule: Every non-component manifest asset rendered direct-front for at least one frame, plus obsolete front reference/idle evidence. Three-quarter front-right is excluded from the canon and tracked only as a transition dependency.

visualMetadataExclusions.keeper_bath_enter: metadata ends at sitting-front, but all eight rendered frames remain side-facing
visualMetadataExclusions.keeper_bath_exit: metadata starts at sitting-front, but all eight rendered frames remain side-facing

withdrawnProvenance.reason: Frank judged the face-to-camera amendments completely wrong.

withdrawn.rejectionReason: The front pose loses the defined moustache and mouth and collapses them into the cheesy pixie grin Frank explicitly rejected.
Frank judged all eight poses unacceptable and explicitly reverted the complete amendment to the previous canonical version.

deleted.reason: Frank judged every pose terrible and explicitly requested deletion and reversion to the previous version.
deleted.recovery: Rejected files remain recoverable from Git history before their explicit deletion; canonical raw and runtime assets were never changed.
